title: Square Enix is turning slimes into AI chatbots in Dragon Quest X using Google's Gemini
content: Square Enix has announced a partnership with Google to integrate Gemini AI into Dragon Quest X, turning in-game slime characters into AI-powered chatbots capable of holding conversations with players. The feature represents one of the first major deployments of a frontier LLM as an interactive NPC system in a live MMORPG.
